Portrait Photography Pricing

Professional photography for LinkedIn, personal branding and teams. All sessions take place in my studio in Bern, Switzerland or at locations within the city.

Prices include preparation, the session, selection and professional editing.

Professional portrait

For people who need a clear and professional image for LinkedIn and their website.

Includes:

  • Studio session
  • Guidance during the session
  • Photo selection
  • Edited images
  • Digital delivery

From CHF 150

Personal branding

For people who need a collection of images for their online presence, social media and communication.

Includes:

  • Longer session
  • Different looks
  • Varied crops
  • Edited photos
  • Digital delivery

From CHF 350

Teams and small businesses

For companies and teams in Bern who need portraits of their members for their website and communication.

Includes:

  • Studio or office session
  • Individual guidance
  • Professional editing
  • Digital delivery

From CHF 350
